name: Reporter Lines: cs_lines L8-L18 + extras
description: Tests: cs_lines L8 (PercentFormat), L9 (BpsFormat), L10 (MonetaryFormat), L11 (IntegerFormat), L12 (LineStyle), L13 (DataLabels), L14 (AxisLabels), L15 (Filter), L16 (FilterAgg), L17 (Step/Smooth/Log), L18 (PlotBands); cs_labeled_lines L5 (AggMean), L6 (Filtered), L7 (Colors+Ref), L8 (Cosmetic); xy_lines L23 (XAxisFormat); labeled_lines L8 (Cosmetic)
source:
# ========================================================================
# Lines Family Handbook Extension — 17 Missing Layouts
# Assets: SPY, QQQ, DIA | Timeframe: 1D
# ========================================================================

# === Market Data ===
src = study_assets()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# === Core Derived Series ===
daily_ret = (close - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)
cum_ret = agg(daily_ret, AggregationType.Sum)
sma_5 = sma(close, 5)
sma_10 = sma(close, 10)
sma_20 = sma(close, 20)
sma_50 = sma(close, 50)
sma_60 = sma(close, 60)
sma_120 = sma(close, 120)
sma_200 = sma(close, 200)
rsi_14 = rsi(close, 14)
ts = index()

# Running count (numeric X axis)
ones = close / close
bar_count = agg(ones, AggregationType.Sum)

# Step signal (above/below SMA 50)
position_flag = 1.0 if close > sma_50 else 0.0

# Normalized close
norm_close = close / sma_200

# Percentage returns over various lookbacks
ret_1w = (close - (close >> 5)) / (close >> 5)
ret_2w = (close - (close >> 10)) / (close >> 10)
ret_1m = (close - (close >> 21)) / (close >> 21)
ret_3m = (close - (close >> 63)) / (close >> 63)
ret_6m = (close - (close >> 126)) / (close >> 126)

# Carry proxies for cs_labeled_lines L7 (multi-tenor carry analog)
carry_1m = daily_ret * 21
carry_3m = daily_ret * 63
carry_6m = daily_ret * 126
carry_1y = daily_ret * 252
carry_2y = daily_ret * 504

# Yield-curve proxies for labeled_lines L8 (7 tenors)
yields_1m = sma_5 / close
yields_3m = sma_10 / close
yields_6m = sma_20 / close
yields_1y = sma_50 / close
yields_2y = sma_60 / close
yields_5y = sma_120 / close
yields_10y = sma_200 / close

# ========================================================================
# CROSS-SECTIONAL LINES (cs_lines) — L8 through L18
# ========================================================================

# L8: PercentFormat y_axis
cs_lines(
    title='L8: Daily Return (PercentFormat)',
    category='18 cs_L8: PercentFormat',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

# L9: BpsFormat y_axis
cs_lines(
    title='L9: Daily Return (BpsFormat)',
    category='19 cs_L9: BpsFormat',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.BpsFormat
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

# L10: MonetaryFormat y_axis
cs_lines(
    title='L10: Close (MonetaryFormat)',
    category='20 cs_L10: MonetaryFormat',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat
)(x_values=ts, y_values=close)

# L11: IntegerFormat y_axis
cs_lines(
    title='L11: Close (IntegerFormat)',
    category='21 cs_L11: IntegerFormat',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat
)(x_values=ts, y_values=close)

# L12: line_width + dash_style
cs_lines(
    title='L12: Dashed Wide Lines',
    category='22 cs_L12: LineStyle',
    line_width=3,
    dash_style=DashStyle.Dash
)(x_values=ts, y_values=cum_ret)

# L13: data_labels
cs_lines(
    title='L13: Per-Asset with Data Labels',
    category='23 cs_L13: DataLabels',
    data_labels=True,
    max_assets=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=cum_ret)

# L14: axis labels + format
cs_lines(
    title='L14: Full Axis Config',
    category='24 cs_L14: AxisLabels',
    x_axis_label='Date',
    y_axis_label='Return (%)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

# L15: AssetFilterSchema (top 2 by y_values)
cs_lines(
    title='L15: Top 2 Assets by Return',
    category='25 cs_L15: Filter',
    filters=AssetFilterSchema(filters=[AssetFilter(column=1, count=2, rank=AssetFilterRank.Top)])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=cum_ret)

# L16: Filter + agg_filtered (aggregate only filtered assets)
cs_lines(
    title='L16: Sum of Top 2 Assets',
    category='26 cs_L16: FilterAgg',
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    agg_filtered=True,
    filters=AssetFilterSchema(filters=[AssetFilter(column=1, count=2, rank=AssetFilterRank.Top)])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=cum_ret)

# L17a: Step line
cs_lines(
    title='L17a: Step Line (Position Flag)',
    category='27 cs_L17: Step',
    step=StepType.StepLeft
)(x_values=ts, y_values=position_flag)

# L17b: Smooth spline
cs_lines(
    title='L17b: Smooth Spline (Returns)',
    category='28 cs_L17: Smooth',
    smooth=True
)(x_values=ts, y_values=daily_ret)

# L17c: Log scale
cs_lines(
    title='L17c: Log Scale (Price)',
    category='29 cs_L17: LogScale',
    log_scale=True
)(x_values=ts, y_values=close)

# L18: Plot bands (y and x)
cs_lines(
    title='L18: RSI with Y+X Plot Bands',
    category='30 cs_L18: PlotBands',
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=70, to=100, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.1, label='Overbought'),
        PlotBand(from=0, to=30, color=Color.Green, opacity=0.1, label='Oversold')
    ]),
    x_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=1640995200000, to=1656633600000, color=Color.Gray, opacity=0.1, label='H1 2022')
    ])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=rsi_14)

# ========================================================================
# CROSS-SECTIONAL LABELED LINES (cs_labeled_lines) — L5 through L8
# ========================================================================

# L5: Aggregated single line (Mean)
cs_labeled_lines(
    title='L5: Mean Return Profile',
    category='31 cs_labeled_L5: AggMean',
    x_labels=['1W', '2W', '1M', '3M', '6M'],
    agg=AggregationType.Mean
)(ret_1w, ret_2w, ret_1m, ret_3m, ret_6m)

# L6: Filtered assets
cs_labeled_lines(
    title='L6: Top 3 SMA Profiles',
    category='32 cs_labeled_L6: Filtered',
    x_labels=['5D', '10D', '20D', '60D', '120D'],
    filters=AssetFilterSchema(filters=[
        AssetFilter(column=0, count=3, rank=AssetFilterRank.Top)
    ]),
    max_assets=3
)(sma_5, sma_10, sma_20, sma_60, sma_120)

# L7: Colors + reference line
cs_labeled_lines(
    title='L7: Carry Profile with Colors + Ref',
    category='33 cs_labeled_L7: ColorsRef',
    x_labels=['1M', '3M', '6M', '1Y', '2Y'],
    colors=[Color.Red, Color.Blue, Color.Green],
    y_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray)
    ])
)(carry_1m, carry_3m, carry_6m, carry_1y, carry_2y)

# L8: Cosmetic options (smooth + data_labels + axis labels + dp)
cs_labeled_lines(
    title='L8: SMA Profiles (Styled)',
    category='34 cs_labeled_L8: Cosmetic',
    x_labels=['5D', '10D', '20D', '60D', '120D'],
    smooth=True,
    data_labels=True,
    x_axis_label='Lookback',
    y_axis_label='SMA Value',
    y_axis_dp=2
)(sma_5, sma_10, sma_20, sma_60, sma_120)

# ========================================================================
# XY LINES — L23
# ========================================================================

# L23: X axis format (PercentFormat on X, MonetaryFormat on Y)
xy_lines(
    title='L23: Return vs Price (X Axis Format)',
    category='35 xy_L23: XAxisFormat',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Price vs Return', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=daily_ret, y_values=close)

# ========================================================================
# LABELED LINES — L8
# ========================================================================

# L8: Cosmetic options (smooth + data_labels + axis labels + dp)
labeled_lines(
    title='L8: Yield Curve (Styled)',
    category='36 labeled_L8: Cosmetic',
    smooth=True,
    data_labels=True,
    x_axis_label='Tenor',
    y_axis_label='Yield (%)',
    y_axis_dp=3,
    series=LabeledLineSeriesSchema(
        x_labels=['1M', '3M', '6M', '1Y', '2Y', '5Y', '10Y'],
        series=[LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='Current', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker, agg=AggregationType.Last)]
    )
)(yields_1m, yields_3m, yields_6m, yields_1y, yields_2y, yields_5y, yields_10y)
